gloss_en: poor person / pauper (עָנִי, fem. עֲנִיָּה) — one who possesses nothing of their own and must receive from others; used kabbalistically for the destitute recipient-aspect (Malkhut as 'poor and lowly, having nothing of her own,' and the Ark of the Covenant as the pauper receiving from the curtain/giver). Not עֳנִי 'affliction' or the verb ענה 'to answer.'
